reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many different callees including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these callees have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow processing requests but the delay is before their processing starts.
Frontend's own p95 latency is very high at 1450.81ms, while its CPU usage is 74% of a very low CPU limit (0.01 cores), indicating CPU throttling and resource exhaustion.
No other service shows multiple independent callers slow toward it or high server-side latency, so frontend is the root cause.
The pod was recently recreated due to a CPU limit change from 200m to 10m, which likely caused the resource exhaustion.

Propagation path includes productcatalogservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, recommendationservice, adservice, and shippingservice as they all experience increased latency due to frontend delays.
